reviewer: independent reviewer B, Gate B wave C
verdictRationale: This family needs an owner's decision before any technical correction is worth making. AOC-CR-296 is captioned 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', its identity block is 'Name And Address Of Defendant', its signature block is 'District Attorney Name (type or print)' and 'Signature', and it states on its own face that it 'is filed by the district attorney' and 'does not require the payment of a filing fee'. Its page 2 closes with a NOTE TO DISTRICT ATTORNEY. The source record nevertheless classifies it documentOwnership 'participant_completed' and participantFillable true, and the artifact is a prosecutor's instrument pre-filled with the participant's identity. Whether LegalEase should hand a participant a district attorney's petition at all is not a question this reviewer can settle, and it decides whether the two technical corrections below need making. Those two are recorded and remain required if the family is kept: the defendant's street address is refused and missing from the filing, and DLState carries the participant's residence state where the form asks for the licence-issuing state.

historicalObjections.originalObjection: protection established by geometry where required, not label alone
historicalObjections.reviewerFinding: Not closed for this family, and this is where the unsound geometry does visible damage. StreetAddr and MailAddr — the defendant's own address lines, sitting at x=38 directly between the bound name line at y=652..665 and the bound city line at y=626 — are refused as protected_page_region, category prosecutor, under regionHeading 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION'. That heading is a line of the form's title block in the right-hand column, not the section that governs those widgets. The result is a filed petition carrying a name and a city and no street address.

No duplicated or misplaced address value appears — but that is partly because the street address is not written at all. Separately DLState takes participant.state, which the guards do not catch because the field carries no printed caption and the binder had only the field name to work from. See WCB-B-296-DLSTATE.
Emission satisfied; contract verifier still regenerates rather than reads. Still open, as the record says.

findings.severity: systemic, affects all four families in this shard
findings.objection: regionHeading and effectiveLabel are attributed across columns and across rows, so the protection decision is frequently made on text that does not belong to the field.
findings.observedResult: The petitioner name / street / city block occupies one column at x=37-38 with a shared width of 278. Its three widgets receive three different region headings, each a different line of the form's title block in the adjacent right-hand column: on AOC-CR-287 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', 'UNDER G.S. 15A-146(a) OR G.S. 15A-146(a1)' and 'G.S. 15A-146, 15A-150'; on AOC-CR-288 'PETITION AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION', 'UNDER G.S. 15A-146(a2)' and 'G.S. 15A-146, 15A-150'; on AOC-CR-296 'STATE VERSUS', 'DISTRICT ATTORNEY PETITION' and 'AND ORDER OF EXPUNCTION'; on AOC-CR-298 'STATE VERSUS', '(NONVIOLENT MISDEMEANOR(S))' and 'G.S. 15A-145.5, -150'. Separately, effectiveLabel is a whole caption row rather than a field's own caption: PetitionerState, PetitionerZip, DriversLicenseState, Race and Sex on AOC-CR-287, and State, ZipCode, DLState and NameAtty on AOC-CR-288, all carry the identical label 'Drivers License No.StateRaceSex'; DateOfBirth, Sex and AgeAtTimeOfOffense on AOC-CR-287 and DOB and CityAtty on AOC-CR-288 all carry the identical label 'Date Of BirthFull Social Security No.' followed by an undecoded run. The refusal categories that result are untrue on their face: PetitionerZip and NameAtty refused as 'race', DOB and CityAtty refused as 'money', DateOfBirth refused as 'money'. Most such misfires are fail-closed and cost only a false reason, but on AOC-CR-296 the same mechanism refuses two fields the participant must complete, and PROTECT_RULES order means an accidental early match ('money', 'race') pre-empts the correct later rule ('attorney') that the module was extended to catch.
findings.requiredResult: A widget's region is the section heading that governs its own column band, and a widget's effectiveLabel is its own caption, not the concatenation of every caption in the row. A refusal names the reason that actually applies.
findings.smallestCorrection: Constrain region attribution to headings whose horizontal extent overlaps the widget's column, and constrain caption attribution to the caption cell above or left of the widget within that column, rather than the whole row. Re-derive the maps and re-render; no family file is hand-edited.
findings.whyItMattersEvenWhereOutputIsClean: §5 says not to infer safety from a missing class. This is the same hazard with a class present: the class is recorded, is relied on, and is demonstrably not about the field it is attached to. Where it happens to fail closed the artifact is still correct; there is no guarantee the next form fails in the safe direction.

findings.fieldOrRectangle: DLState, rect x=177 y=602 w=45 h=16
findings.observedResult: DLState is bound to participant.state on factBasis field_name. The census records labelBasis 'no_printed_caption_within_reach', so the binder matched the token 'State' inside the field name alone. DLState is the second cell of the 'Drivers License No. | State | Race | Sex' row and sits immediately right of DLNo at x=37 w=138 on the same line; it is the state that issued the driver's licence, not the participant's state of residence. The canonical fixture hides the error because participant.state is 'XX' and both readings render identically.
findings.requiredResult: Either the field is refused, as the equivalent field is on the other three families in this shard — PetitionerState and DLState are refused on AOC-CR-287, AOC-CR-288 and AOC-CR-298 — or it is bound to a driver's-licence-state fact the platform actually holds.
findings.smallestCorrection: Add the driver's-licence cluster to the government_identifier rule's name test so DLState is refused on its name the way DLNo already is, then re-derive and re-render.
findings.inconsistencyNoted: the same conceptual field is refused on three families in this shard and bound on the fourth, which is itself evidence that the decision is not being made on a stable input
